articles.title: Horoscope Tomorrow Thursday, November 19, 2026: Astrological Predictions For All Zodiac Signs (Aries To Pisces)
articles.description: Horoscope Tomorrow: In the mystical world of astrology, the moon takes centre stage as it moves through different houses, influencing the lives of people based on their zodiac signs. Let's take a look at the astrological predictions for tomorrow (November 19) for each sign. Aries Today will be a day for you to move ahead in your work by using your wisdom and understanding. You may participate in a religious event and show great interest in charitable activities. People will also come forward to help you with your work. If you have been facing difficulties with a particular task, your father's support may help you resolve them. Avoid making promises to anyone in haste, as you may find it difficult to fulfil them later. A guest may visit your home, increasing your expenses. Taurus Today, you will need to remain patient while dealing with challenging situations. Your child may make a mistake, so you should pay special attention to their company and social circle. Those in romantic relationships may introduce their partners to family members. If you are running a business in partnership, there is a possibility of being cheated by your business partner. You may get an opportunity to meet a friend after a long time. Students will find new opportunities opening up for higher education. Gemini Today, avoid getting into arguments with your boss over any issue at the workplace, as this could affect your chances of promotion. It will be beneficial for you to avoid eating excessive fried and oily food. People working in the social sector will receive appreciation for their efforts and may also be offered a good position. You may need to seek help from your siblings to complete some important tasks. Some of your opponents may try to create obstacles in your work, but you will easily overcome them with your intelligence. You may also consider purchasing a new house, shop or other property. Cancer Today may be a somewhat confusing day for you. You may take an important decision regarding the challenges your child is facing in their career. You may also have to travel away from home for work-related reasons. You will consider making some changes to your business. You must remain patient while dealing with difficult situations. You may spend money on expensive clothes, a laptop, a mobile phone or other items for yourself. You may also receive money that has been stuck for a long time, strengthening your financial position. Leo Today will bring happiness and positivity into your life. However, you may feel troubled by a particular habit of your spouse, which could become a reason for arguments between you. You will receive full support from your brothers and sisters. By making yoga and exercise a part of your daily routine, you can stay healthy and keep illnesses at bay. Something you say may hurt a family member's feelings. Give priority to important tasks so that you can complete your work on time. You may also consider bringing someone on board as a business partner. Virgo Today will bring positive results for you. You will genuinely wish well for others, but some people may misunderstand your intentions and consider your actions selfish. Nevertheless, you will benefit from your positive outlook. You may be affected by some seasonal illnesses, which could cause you a little discomfort. Those in romantic relationships may go on a long-distance trip with their partners. Make some time to serve and care for your parents, as this will bring you mental peace. Do not allow stress to overpower you. Libra Today is likely to be an ordinary day for you. You will need to exercise great caution while dealing with financial transactions and related schemes. Avoid lending money to anyone. You may face some difficulties while driving. Your child may make a demand, and although fulfilling it may take some time, you will eventually be able to meet it easily. People working in politics may find some shortcomings in their work. Therefore, remain completely focused on your responsibilities, as this will help improve your position and reputation. Scorpio Today, you may face difficulties in completing certain tasks. You may receive disappointing news from your child. Avoid making mistakes at the workplace, as they could affect your chances of promotion. Ongoing conflicts within the family may become a source of stress. It would be better to resolve these issues through mutual discussion. If you are planning to make a decision regarding a family member's career, avoid rushing into it. You also need to remain cautious of enemies and people around you. Sagittarius Today, you should avoid doing things in haste, as rushing through your work may lead to losses. If you offer any suggestions to your boss at the workplace, they are likely to appreciate them. However, you may face some difficulties in your work. You may also make plans to travel abroad. Students may encounter a few challenges in their studies, but they will be able to overcome them with the help of their teachers. Their interest in studies will also increase. Your father may experience an eye-related problem. Capricorn People born under Capricorn may remain troubled by issues related to their income and expenses. You may find it difficult to concentrate on your work, while your mind may remain occupied with various thoughts. However, you will need to make greater efforts to increase your income so that you can manage your daily expenses comfortably. You must remain cautious of your opponents. You may receive some good news from your children. Be careful while using high-speed vehicles. Aquarius Today will open up several new avenues for growth and progress. You will move ahead rapidly with your work. You will also find relief from ongoing business-related problems. You may make plans to purchase a vehicle. You will spend some enjoyable moments with your friends. If a new idea comes to your mind, take immediate steps to implement it in your business. Do not get involved in any arguments or disputes under someone's influence, as this could affect your work. Your family members will give due importance to your opinions. Pisces Today will be filled with happiness, and you will have plenty of reasons to feel delighted, as your child may secure a good job. You will achieve new heights in your career. Avoid letting arrogance take over your personality and move forward in your work with confidence. You may have to undertake a sudden journey due to some work-related reasons, which is likely to prove beneficial for you. If you seek help from your colleagues, they will readily support you. You may make a request to your mother, which she will certainly fulfil. [Disclaimer: The content of this article is based solely on astrological predictions, and should be taken as general guidance. Individual experiences may vary. ABPLive.com does not assert the accuracy or validity of any claims or information presented. It is strongly recommended to consult a qualified expert before considering or implementing any information or belief discussed herein.]

articles.title: Bigg Boss 20: Poonam Goel Reveals Why Husband Manish Goel Is Upset With Qazi Touqeer’s ‘Professor’ Remark
articles.description: Poonam Narula Goel has broken her silence in support of her husband, actor Manish Goel, amid his ongoing disagreement with Qazi Touqeer on Bigg Boss 20. Taking to social media, Poonam explained why Manish gets upset whenever Qazi addresses him as ‘Professor’. She alleged that the remark is part of a repeated pattern of mocking and age-related taunts, adding that her husband's reactions come from genuine hurt rather than a desire for television footage. Poonam Narula Goel Explains Why Manish Goel Objects To ‘Professor’ Remark In an Instagram post, Poonam said she had remained quiet for more than a month but felt it was time to address the situation. She promised to share more details after the upcoming episode while explaining the background behind Manish's reactions. She wrote, “I have been patient and stayed silent for over a month, but it's high time I put this out. I'll speak in detail after tomorrow's episode, but for now, I want people to understand why Manish reacts to the word 'Professor.' Ever since Manish entered the house, Qazi has constantly poked him with names like 'Gyani Baba' and 'Professor.'” According to Poonam, what began as a joke gradually turned into repeated remarks that left Manish uncomfortable. She claimed other contestants initially joined Qazi in the prank, and Manish even participated without knowing what was happening. “Manish had no idea about it but still took it sportingly, joined them and even danced along, which wasn't telecasted. However, Qazi kept taking it further with condescending remarks and age-shaming. When Manish finally asked him to stop and draw a line, Qazi told the camera that he would make Manish cry and wouldn't stop.” She maintained that this was the real reason behind her husband's response whenever Qazi used the word ‘Professor’. 'He Doesn't Care About Screen Time' Poonam also rejected suggestions that Manish deliberately approaches Qazi to create confrontations or gain attention on the reality show. Describing her husband's temperament, she said he is emotional and expressive but doesn't manufacture situations for the cameras. “Manish speaks this way in real life. He loves and takes pride in his language, Shudh Hindi. He is an actor, and we are proud of him. But sometimes, you need to look beyond edited footage and look into a person's eyes to understand when they are genuinely hurt and when they are acting. It's disappointing to see what people choose to endorse today. But we will always stand by each other as a family." She further urged viewers not to let their support for Qazi prevent them from understanding Manish's perspective. Poonam pointed out that her husband had even sacrificed his lifeline for Qazi, arguing that this contradicted the suggestion that he was primarily concerned about his position in the competition. She also spoke about the expectations viewers place on contestants, particularly older participants, saying a 51-year-old man shouldn't have to behave in an exaggerated manner to earn acceptance. Poonam concluded by reiterating her family's support for Manish, maintaining that his personality on the show reflects who he is outside the Bigg Boss house. (With inputs from IANS)
